title: Anonymized Multi-Turn Conversation Flow (BSP Architecture)
description: Defines a directed graph of Bulk Synchronous Parallel supersteps for orchestration of multiple LLM agents.

flow_id.description: Unique identifier for this conversation topology.

global_timeout_ms.description: Hard cutoff for the entire execution to prevent hung processes.

models.description: Global list of models available for this workflow. Referenced by perspective_matrix or individual workers.

scope_alignment.description: Optional: Enable scope alignment to prevent role drift by refining worker responsibilities before execution.

scope_construction_timeout_ms.description: Timeout for Phase 1 scope construction per worker

variables.description: The 'Memory' of the flow. These are the keys that can be read/written by Reducers.

supersteps.description: The sequence of synchronized steps. Each step MUST complete before the next begins.

step_id.description: Unique ID for logging and transitioning.

global_instruction_overlay.description: Instruction appended to ALL workers in this step (e.g., 'Be concise').

perspectives.description: Model-neutral instructions (DEFAULT). Each perspective is analyzed by all models unless model_ref is specified for a specific model binding.

instruction.description: What to analyze/predict from this perspective

model_ref.description: OPTIONAL: Bind this perspective to a specific model (special case opt-out from model-neutral default). Example: 'openai/gpt-4'

middleware_phase.description: Pipeline of operations applied to worker outputs before the Reducer sees them.

apply_to.description: List of worker_ids to apply this to, or ['*'] for all.

output_write_to.description: Name of the variable to update with the result.

strategy.description: Reduction strategy. 'column_wise_summary' groups worker outputs by perspective and creates per-perspective summaries. 'score_and_rank' performs anonymous peer review and ranking.

variable_interpolation.description: Enable ${variable_name} interpolation in chairman_instructions and global_instruction_overlay.

visibility.description: Strict controls on what the Reducer is allowed to see.

include_rejected_items.description: Should the chairman see items dropped by middleware?

include_conversation_history.description: If false, only sends current query without any prior context (clean subquery).

include_worker_outputs.description: If false, reducer ignores worker outputs (for single-model subqueries).

chairman_instructions.description: Specific logic for the decision maker (e.g., 'Side with security if risk > low').

ranking_instructions.description: Custom criteria for evaluating responses (used by score_and_rank strategy).

evaluator_models.description: Models to use as evaluators for score_and_rank strategy (defaults to [model_ref]).

ranking_algorithm.description: Algorithm to use for score_and_rank strategy.

require_complete_rankings.description: If true, reject evaluations that don't rank all responses (score_and_rank only).

ScoreAndRankSuperstep.description: Special superstep type for anonymous peer review and ranking. Multiple evaluator models receive full conversation history and rank previous outputs. Rankings are aggregated algorithmically (not by LLM).

superstep_type.description: Identifies this as a score_and_rank superstep

step_id.description: Unique ID for logging and transitioning

description.description: Human-readable intent (e.g., 'Peer review of initial analyses')

evaluator_models.description: Models that will judge and rank previous outputs. These models work in parallel, not sequentially.

ranking_instructions.default: Rank responses by quality, accuracy, and usefulness.
ranking_instructions.description: Custom evaluation criteria for the evaluators

visibility.description: Controls what conversation history evaluators see

include_conversation_history.description: Include full conversation from previous supersteps

mask_worker_identities.description: Anonymize worker IDs to 'Response A', 'Response B', etc.

oneOf.description: 'all' for all previous supersteps, 'latest' for only the immediately previous superstep

include_supersteps.description: Which supersteps to include in conversation history

ranking_algorithm.description: Algorithm for aggregating rankings: average_position (simple average), borda_count (positional scoring), ranked_pairs (Tideman), schulze (beatpath)

output_write_to.description: Variable name to write the ranking results

output_format.description: Format of output: leaderboard (street ranking card), full (complete evaluation data), rankings_only (sorted worker IDs)

require_complete_rankings.description: If true, reject evaluations that don't rank all responses
